'''Dex''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a member of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] once saved [[Blue Five (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Five]] from [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and became an [[Ace/Legends|ace]]. During the [[ambush on Ral's Run]], she became the first member of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to shoot down a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] by destroying the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier]] ''[[Imperial Protector]]''.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dex was mentioned in the opening story of [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
